scope: Focused primary-source comparison, not an exhaustive systematic review. Published results are not replications on the Aitken split.

sources.label: Aitken original results
sources.reference: Aitken project, London model performance and research protocol, saved release results, Sep. 2026.

sources.label: Danesh Yazdi et al 2020
sources.reference: M. Danesh Yazdi et al., "Predicting Fine Particulate Matter (PM2.5) in the Greater London Area: An Ensemble Approach using Machine Learning Methods," Remote Sensing, vol. 12, no. 6, Art. no. 914, 2020, doi: 10.3390/rs12060914.
sources.verified_facts: Overall ten-fold monitor-held-out CV R2 0.828 and RMSE 4.231; temporal R2 0.882 and spatial R2 0.396. Daily 1 km London maps 2005-2013. Target archive augmented using PM10 and NOx predictions; AOD input. Not the Aitken test.

sources.label: Dimakopoulou et al 2022
sources.reference: K. Dimakopoulou et al., "Development and Evaluation of Spatio-Temporal Air Pollution Exposure Models and Their Combinations in the Greater London Area, UK," International Journal of Environmental Research and Public Health, vol. 19, no. 9, Art. no. 5401, 2022, doi: 10.3390/ijerph19095401.
sources.verified_facts: Daily London 2009-2013, 104 PM2.5 sites including reconstructed targets. CV R2: ST LUR .66, dispersion .74, ML ensemble .83, Hybrid 1 .81, Hybrid 2 .79. Hybrid here is not HGB plus U-Net. GAM fusion uses cross-validated model predictions.
sources.caution: Do not portray .66-.83 as one model confidence interval. PM2.5 RMSE .20 for Hybrid 1 in Table 3 is not used as a ranking claim; scales and manuscript table inconsistencies warrant caution.

sources.label: Schneider et al 2020
sources.reference: R. Schneider et al., "A Satellite-Based Spatio-Temporal Machine Learning Model to Reconstruct Daily PM2.5 Concentrations across Great Britain," Remote Sensing, vol. 12, no. 22, Art. no. 3803, 2020, doi: 10.3390/rs12223803.
sources.locator: Abstract; model stages and validation; Table 4
sources.verified_facts: Great Britain 2008-2018 daily 1 km random-forest mapping. Mean CV R2 .767, temporal .795, spatial .658. AOD, PM10-derived PM2.5 and atmospheric-model predictors. Nationwide score, not London-only.

sources.label: Legaria Santiago et al 2026
sources.reference: V. Legaria-Santiago, A. Arguelles, M. Saldana-Perez, J. Richardson, and M. Bona, "Leveraging Remote Traffic Data for Local Air Pollutant Estimation: A Scenario-Based Machine Learning Study Across London Monitoring Sites," Atmosphere, vol. 17, no. 8, Art. no. 806, 2026, doi: 10.3390/atmos17080806.
sources.locator: Accepted manuscript Table 7 and Sections 2.1-2.3; journal reference confirmed on arXiv abstract page
sources.verified_facts: Hourly London observations 23 Jun-12 Dec 2025. Scenario 2 with traffic and neighbouring pollution: Marylebone RF RMSE3.32 MAE2.44 R2.53; Camden Extra Trees RMSE2.41 MAE1.89 R2.69. Scenario-specific scores, not a pooled city map evaluation.

sources.label: Galindo Prieto et al 2026
sources.reference: B. Galindo-Prieto, A. Papanicolaou, and I. S. Mudway, "Partial Least Squares Regression Models for Outdoor Air Pollutant Forecasting," Journal of Chemometrics, vol. 40, no. 7, Art. no. e70156, 2026, doi: 10.1002/cem.70156.
sources.verified_facts: Air-01 London 2019-2022, target site CT3; 80/20 split, other pollutant and weather predictors. Back-transformed test R2 .796, RMSEP2.261, MAEP1.703. Transformed-space R2 .688 must not be substituted.
sources.caution: Paper includes imputation and model comparison on test results; numerical result is author-reported, not independently reproduced. Other rows have metric inconsistencies; no SVR superiority claim is imported.

sources.label: Sharma et al 2025
sources.reference: J. Sharma, I. Vallejo, and R. Å. Ødegård, "AirQ-ResUNet: A Residual U-Net Based Deep Learning Surrogate for High-Resolution PM2.5 Prediction in Urban Environments," in Intelligent and Fuzzy Systems, LNNS, vol. 1529, pp. 21-29, 2025, doi: 10.1007/978-3-031-97992-7_3.
sources.verified_facts: Oslo U-Net-style residual model emulates EPISODE dispersion outputs using meteorology and emissions.
sources.caution: Publisher preview does not expose verified numerical results. No R2/RMSE copied. Simulator targets and architecture residuals do not establish equivalence with Aitken HGB residual correction.

sources.label: Ronneberger et al 2015
sources.reference: O. Ronneberger, P. Fischer, and T. Brox, "U-Net: Convolutional Networks for Biomedical Image Segmentation," in MICCAI 2015, LNCS, vol. 9351, pp. 234-241, 2015, doi: 10.1007/978-3-319-24574-4_28.
sources.locator: Original architecture paper; not a London air quality benchmark
